definition: 240 compositional presets across 24 executable families; not 240 independently verified techniques.

families.name: Entrances
families.avoid: Avoid hiding critical headings or primary controls.
families.performance: Transform/opacity; short and once.
families.mobile: Keep text visible; shorten travel on narrow screens.
families.accessibility: Native HTML controls, complete labels, keyboard alternatives, and readable final state.
families.reducedMotion: Render the final state immediately; retain all controls and information.
families.evidence: Authored executable family. See validation/MOTION-UPDATE.md for measured checks.
